title: 02 Thrum: notes
strengths: The right content for 'how hard am I working': zone name, BPM, a five-step bar with the current segment raised, time in zone.
Pure white numeral on black with one warm accent and no glow after the colour pass.
slop_signals: The 104 px '162' fills the display width and the heart glyph and 'BPM' are tucked under its last digit, so the hero numeral and its unit collide.
A heart glyph as decoration beside 'BPM'.
A tiny zone-coloured trace along the bottom edge with no axis, cropped by the display corners: a sparkline for its own sake.
The zone bar and the '1 2 3 4 5' row under it say the same thing twice.
fixes: Set the numeral at about 88 px with 'BPM' on its baseline to the right; drop the heart.
Remove the bottom trace, or give it a third of the display clear of the corners.
Keep the zone bar and drop the numeral row under it; the raised segment already says 4.

references.what: Zone arc, a 'ZONE 0' label and a big number: three things, nothing else.
The active zone segment is raised and labelled in words; BPM sits beside the number at its own size.
Heart rate with a five-band bar under it, bands labelled once.
Z0 to Z5 colour scale with a marker: the heat ramp this piece's bar uses.

owner.said: most of the watch screens are okay

round4.pairwise: won 4 vs WorkOutDoors, won 4 vs HeartWatch, won 3 vs Zones for Training (blind, 18 Oct; tested before the audit fixes)
changed: 162 set at weight 600 instead of the ultra-heavy cut, with 'bpm' beside it at its own size; the heart icon removed
Gradient zone bar and gradient trace removed; five flat segments, only zone 4 in red
Title 'Rep 3 of 6' in grey so red means only the zone; the group moved up under the numeral
